visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short black hair tied in two small ponytails is seen walking across a light-colored wooden floor in a brightly lit indoor living room. She is wearing a cream-colored long-sleeved sweater with a brown diagonal patch and dark grey pants. In the background, there are shelves filled with various colorful toys, a wooden staircase, and a white beanbag on the floor. (2) The girl approaches another slightly older girl who is lying face down on a large white beanbag, apparently sleeping. The younger girl leans over her, shouts with her mouth wide open, and attempts to wake her by gently poking her shoulder and face. The lighting remains bright and natural, coming from a large window. (3) The younger girl continues her attempts to wake the sleeping sister by climbing onto the beanbag and eventually lying on top of the older girl's back. She looks towards the camera with a curious and playful facial expression, holding a small brown object in her hand. The background shows a wooden coffee table with a water bottle on it. (4) The younger girl sits on the older girl's back, then moves to poke the back of her head and play with her hair. The older girl remains mostly stationary, face down. Finally, the older girl rolls over and begins to wake up, stretching her arms above her head while lying on the beanbag. The younger girl smiles at the camera and forms a heart shape over her head with her hands. The scene ends with a pink screen showing a cartoon character logo.
